steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Voltage is the potential difference that drives charge through a circuit, measured in volts (V). | Key Fact: Current is the rate of flow of charge, measured in amperes (A); 1 A = 1 C/s. | Key Fact: Resistance opposes the flow of current, measured in ohms (Ω). | Key Fact: Ohm's Law states V = IR, linking voltage, current and resistance linearly for ohmic conductors.
